notes.title: UPDATE notice
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004887/d23c2d67bb680511b0156af675cb04393d4fe8f6.png[/img]

hello. I'm Kim Sangwon, the developer.
Thank you for playing the game as soon as it was released. 
I didn't add wasabi to make sushi.
I am planning several patches.

1. change the flapping system
2. added traps, securing the way to the ending
3. print clear time history
4. lots of other fun stuff 

ALTF4 didn't have SAVE balloons, corpse spawns, etc. in the beginning.
We will continue to make the game better with many patches.

We will continue to work on small patches.
Another small update is planned for tonight.
Thank you.

And if you have any funny suggestions, please leave them in the comments. We'll take them into consideration.

P.S. Part 2 of ALTF4 is officially coming out next week, and while it's probably spicier, we'll make sure IDONTFALL is a reward for your support.
We'll also be updating the 11th floor. 
... Thank you. It's hard being a lone developer, but I'm glad you like it, so I'll keep up the good work.
